#!/bin/bash
set -e
source /root/miniconda3/bin/activate rap-inference
export TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST=12.0
export CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-12.8
export FORCE_CUDA=1
export MAX_JOBS=2
pip install -v --no-build-isolation git+https://github.com/facebookresearch/pytorch3d.git@stable 2>&1 | tee /root/pytorch3d_build.log
correction_to_first_build_scan: The first scan handled .log files only and incorrectly labelled this existing .sh file NOT_PRESENT. Its actual bytes are now preserved.
